'''Taylor Hayward''' (DeckTech handle '''JediMaster10''')<ref name="dt-23334">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23334 I like blowin sht up], DeckTech (Taylor "JediMaster10" Hayward, 13 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23334/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23334/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009174938/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23334/ Wayback Machine].</ref> posted a [[Light]] [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Rebel Strike Team]] list on DeckTech. He posted a [[Light]] [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|Agents In The Court]] list on DeckTech (''Agents In The Court'')<ref name="dt-23121">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23121 Agents In The Court], DeckTech (Taylor "JediMaster10" Hayward, 4 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23121/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23121/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009194323/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23121/ Wayback Machine].</ref>. He posted a [[Light]] [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]] list on DeckTech (''A Hidden Base Deck'')<ref name="dt-23033">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23033 A Hidden Base Deck], DeckTech (Taylor "JediMaster10" Hayward, 28 April 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23033/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23033/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009205018/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23033/ Wayback Machine].</ref>.
